reason: I already have my supplement I reorder when it runs out, and I'm not looking to swap it for something from a brand I've never heard of. The lab report thing is nice, but I'd still be taking a chance on a new brand with my money.
objection: Is it really tested, or just marketing? A lab report on a page is only as good as the lab, and I can't tell if it's real.
would_change_my_mind: A named lab I can look up myself with a real report for the batch I'm buying, plus a few creators I follow showing they use it. Then I'd try one box at the launch price.
